case.summary: This case was opened following an analyst request to review transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 due to an unusual device profile. Graph analysis determined a fraud verdict with a probability of 0.90, identifying an undocumented device-profile ring affecting two transactions totaling $187.33. Recommended actions include blocking the card via L1, creating a case, filing an L2 report, monitoring connected cards, and escalating to an analyst under policies R1, R6, and R9.

sar.narrative: Customer C13487 using card C13487-K1 is implicated in a coordinated fraud scheme. A total of 2 transactions amounting to $187.33 were identified as fraudulent. The activity occurred between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22. Channels involved online purchases routed through billing regions 191.0 and 272.0. The transactions utilized device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 behind an anonymous proxy, which was marked as new for the account. This activity is suspicious because the rare device profile links to a ring of multiple other cards including C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06710-K1, C08168-K1, C09049-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10193-K2, C10326-K1, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C12796-K1, and C13291-K1 involved in similar past fraud. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a case, filing a regulatory report, monitoring connected cards, and escalating to an analyst.
